svg.title: Runtime flow: boot, request, five nodes, branches, terminal state
svg.desc: A labelled illustration of the NL2SQL request path. Boot starts main.py, builds the FastAPI app, runs the lifespan probes and serves. A request passes the operator gate, request validation, admission and session binding, then request_query.yml drives five nodes through WorkflowRunner. Guard rails apply per step. Branches cover skips, validation blocks, node exceptions and HTTP error classes. Every path ends in an explicit status, one shared result contract and a persisted trace.
